purpose: Replace the fixture-only process-wide file-size limit with bounded private log capture.

change_scope.context: Add CommandCaptureError and _OwnedCommandCapture; replace command_with_bound; add selectors/signal imports. Original Context/open_context/InstalledFixture and Main/held/lease/source/phase code remain byte-identical.
change_scope.transport: Only output/capture first-error routing before generic return-code classification; an already observed nonzero exit remains primary over later capture/close errors.
change_scope.output_capture: Concurrent nonblocking pipes; full EOF is required for complete capture. Persist only each bounded prefix in exclusive private stdout/stderr files; preserve original R6 intent/receipt names and original now/write_new function bodies.
change_scope.lifecycle: One newly started session. pidfd and getpgid/getsid checks anchor only the unreaped direct leader. WNOHANG|WNOWAIT observes it without reaping. Group signal precedes any Popen.wait; no poll/communicate. At most five seconds for direct-child retirement, with closed FD ledger and actual timestamps. No group signal after reaping begins.
change_scope.first_error: A capture error that precedes any observed nonzero leader exit remains primary over cleanup-induced nonzero status. Prior observed Android failure stays primary; fsync/close errors remain secondary. Timeout/overflow evidence is retained, never reclassified as success.
scope_not_qualified: New Main/Android execution or namespace entry

host_controls.files: Seven synthetic own regular authority files; fixed own case directories, intent/result/stdout/stderr and one >1 MiB own artifact. All cleanup uses held own directory FDs; no directory scan.
declared_seams: Context Main/target guard is synthetic and does no Main read.
Two overflow tests use real BoundArun with synthetic held entry and the real own-host-child runner; the synthetic helper argv is never executed.
Two order controls use real remember and BoundArun with an explicit CompletedProcess seam, without a child.
before_after: all known fixture files and directory FDs closed/removed
host_controls.Python_execution: NOT_PERFORMED; to be established by Root's one exact request.

future_runtime: No new run/retire request or nonce is generated here. A future runtime needs actual successful host controls, fresh phase material/root, a new exact source binding, and the actual successful retirement authority.
